CraftMind creates validated Minecraft block-placement plans from text using a configured AI provider. Image and URL references are preserved but not analyzed in Phase 2. Minecraft execution is reserved for Phase 3.

When you request a plan, CraftMind sends your text prompt to the selected provider (currently OpenAI) over HTTPS. Image and URL references are not sent or analyzed. API credentials are encrypted at rest with Android Keystore-backed AES-GCM; provider/model settings contain identifiers only. Provider privacy and retention terms still apply.
Only implemented HTTPS providers are listed. Requests are text-only; attached images and URLs are not sent.
No implemented AI providers are available.
Enter the exact model ID available to your provider account. It is checked with a non-generative model lookup.
Model lookup succeeded. Generation support is not tested.
Keys are encrypted using Android Keystore-backed AES-GCM. A key is never shown again after saving and is sent only to the selected provider over HTTPS.
Enter a new key to replace the stored key. The current key cannot be viewed.
Use 1–100 letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens; the first character must be a letter or number.
Use a printable ASCII key with no more than 4,096 characters.
